items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And on the other side, it was two, three records. Bill Johnson, bass.

ctx.x: Yeah, on the first cut. Frankie Jackson. No, no. That's the late cut you got. Oh, is that so? Yeah, that's the last cut I made. Oh, yes.

Well, whatever it is, I put it on my tape and then I brought you the record again. I brought it on tape. Yeah, I brought it on tape. Because I wonder if there was something you did on the banjo there on the grab. Yeah, that was made by… And on the other side, it was two, three records. Bill Johnson, bass.
Yeah, bass, yeah. Called Ake Robertson's Bull Fiddle Band. Yeah. And Count Turner on the banjo. Yeah, yeah. And I was playing banjo and Bobby Warren fiddle.
